_comment: The generator and grader models `ecf eval generate` and `grade` accept (eval generate plan, Model switches; P24; ADR 0034's closed provider list). Family is the lab that made the model, not who hosts it. Unknown ids are refused; `excluded` names hosted models from labs the model filter bars (PRC-, Meta- and X-affiliated labs; Qwen and Qwen-based models, OD-494), so the refusal says why. The Claude entries match ecf_server/data/models.lock (a test checks). Prices are US$ per 1M tokens, for --max-cost.
